image.headline: Reach brings likes. Inquiries only come from clarity

samples.caption:
Three months of consistent posting, decent reach — and still barely any concrete inquiries.

Visibility brings people to you. Whether that turns into a conversation depends on what comes next: do they understand within seconds what you solve, who you work with, and what the first step is?

What's stopping people from taking the next step with you right now?

image.headline: Most people don't buy from the best — they buy from the one they know

samples.caption:
Reach feels pointless — until someone reaches out who's been quietly following you for months.

Visibility rarely sells immediately. It keeps you top of mind for when the need arises — and then people ask the one they already feel they know, not the stranger with the better ad.

When did someone last reach out to you simply because they already knew you?
